channel.title: Agentic Engineering — Audio Edition
channel.description: Narrated chapters of the Agentic Engineering field guide. Unlisted feed - keep the URL private.

item.title: 01 · Experimentation
item.description: Hypotheses, paired comparisons, confounders, uncertainty, and a decision log that compounds.

item.title: 02 · Engineering foundations
item.description: Contracts, tenant isolation, transactions, deadlines, observability, and deployable boundaries.

item.title: 03 · Jobs & events
item.description: At-least-once delivery, idempotency, leases, transactional outboxes, backpressure, and recovery.

item.title: 04 · LLM gateways
item.description: Policy-first routing, fallback eligibility, spend reservations, caching, and failure containment.

item.title: 05 · Agent design
item.description: Harnesses, tool contracts, bounded loops, memory, prompt injection, and approval-bound actions.

item.title: 06 · Evaluations
item.description: Task suites, outcome graders, human calibration, repeated trials, holdouts, and release gates.

item.title: 07 · Inference infrastructure
item.description: Prefill and decode, weights and KV cache, batching, quantization, parallelism, and hosting decisions.

item.title: 08 · Load testing
item.description: Arrival patterns, queueing, tail latency, goodput, reproducibility, and defensible capacity reports.

item.title: 09 · Data retention
item.description: ZDR scope, persistence inventories, ephemeral processing, deletion evidence, and incident handling.

item.title: 10 · Kernels & performance
item.description: Profiling, arithmetic intensity, roofline reasoning, fusion, correctness, and honest GPU timing.

item.title: 11 · Ontologies & semantics
item.description: Canonical entities, provenance, temporal facts, RAG versus graphs, formal semantics, and policy.

item.title: 12 · Cost of cognition
item.description: Unit economics, retry costs, review time, break-even utilization, routing experiments, and budgets.

item.title: 13 · Agentic security
item.description: OWASP agentic threats, injection-defense patterns, CaMeL, MCP poisoning, and sandboxing practice.

item.title: 14 · Agent identity
item.description: Own versus delegated authority, workload identity, token exchange, and per-call subject verification.

item.title: 15 · Human oversight operations
item.description: Risk-routed autonomy, approval queues as state machines, exact single-use approvals, and audit-first execution.

item.title: 16 · Context & memory systems
item.description: Context budgets, four memory types, provenance, and compaction that preserves constraints as data.

item.title: 17 · Evals, traces & logs
item.description: Structured logs, GenAI trace spans, and live eval scores joined into one debugging surface.

item.title: 18 · Guardrails in the request path
item.description: Input and output rails, gateway versus app placement, latency budgets, and fail-closed design.

item.title: 19 · Adaptation economics
item.description: Prompt, RAG, and fine-tuning compared on measured quality and cost per accepted outcome.

item.title: 20 · AI Act & governance
item.description: Provider versus deployer duties, classification memos, and mapping obligations to existing artifacts.

item.title: 21 · Tailnets & agent networking
item.description: WireGuard identity, ACLs as capability policy, mesh-local models, Funnel exceptions, and Headscale.

item.title: 22 · Engineering best practices
item.description: Version control, loud tests, CI/CD, review, ADRs, telemetry, and ops hygiene, audited before agent scope grows.

item.title: 23 · The challenge
item.description: One thread across the guide, escalating sprints at 7, 30, 60, and 90 days, each ending in a shipped artifact.

item.title: 24 · MCP vs CLI
item.description: Typed contracts versus pipes, stateless MCP under Streamable HTTP, runtime duties per door, and a decision matrix that hardens repeated work into scripts.

item.title: 25 · Agent runtimes
item.description: Turn loop anatomy, the runtime as an operating system for one agent, and the ownership split between model and runtime.

item.title: 26 · Supervision & lifecycle
item.description: Supervision trees, health definitions, bounded restarts, circuit breakers, and graceful shutdown.

item.title: 27 · State, sessions & statelessness
item.description: The three homes for agent state, the stateless default, contained sessions, and resumability as the acceptance test.

item.title: 28 · Scheduling & event-driven agents
item.description: Durable schedules, leases, missed-fire policy, heartbeats, and trigger-layer event filters with provenance.

item.title: 29 · Isolation & failure containment
item.description: Blast-radius design, per-layer boundaries for compromised, confused, and costly agents, and the containment matrix.

item.title: 30 · The other half of the model
item.description: Harness attribution: quiet failures, null-result diagnosis, instrument lies, and the Monday-morning measurement rules.

item.title: 31 · Sandboxing
item.description: The five walls of the edge: filesystem, egress, credentials, resources, lifetime, with Cloudflare Sandbox SDK as the reference implementation.
